The cost of Bloomerang, a cloud-based donor management software designed for nonprofits, can vary depending on several factors, such as the size of your organization, the number of contacts you need to manage, and any additional features or services you may require.

Typically, Bloomerang offers tiered pricing plans based on the number of constituent records (contacts). These plans often start at a few hundred dollars per year for a small number of records and can increase to several thousand dollars per year for larger databases. In addition to the base price, there may be other costs for things like additional user licenses, training, support, or integration with other software.

To get the most accurate and up-to-date pricing information, it is best to contact Bloomerang directly. They can provide a customized quote based on your specific needs and circumstances. It's also a good idea to inquire about any discounts or special offers that might be available for certain types of nonprofits or during special promotions.
